data.one_liner: Converts hard-to-read toString output from Equatable or Freezed into human-readable formatted strings.
data.what_it_does: Provides a `.toPrettier()` extension method that formats single-line `toString()` outputs from complex objects or strings into multi-line, indented representations. It supports custom indentation, separators, and brackets.
use_when: You want to improve log readability for complex data models generated by Equatable or Freezed.
You need a quick way to pretty-print serialized object strings during debugging.
avoid_when: You require complex object serialization for network transport rather than debugging logs.
strengths: Customizable indentation, separators, and bracket definitions.
Works out-of-the-box with Equatable and Freezed toString outputs.
weaknesses: Limited to string formatting and debugging use cases.
data.setup_notes: No native setup or build runner required.
